result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear data rendering bug ('€NaN delivery') plus a few minor layout/content observations.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed number formatting or missing/invalid delivery fee value.
issues.suggestion: Guard against undefined/null delivery fees before formatting; show a fallback like '€0 delivery', 'Free delivery', or hide the fee line when the value is unavailable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge without an ellipsis, and the last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped to an unreadable sliver.
issues.suggestion: If these are horizontally scrollable carousels this may be intentional, but apply text truncation with ellipsis on names and ensure partially visible items clearly signal scrollability (e.g., consistent peek width).

issues.description: Delivery fee formatting is inconsistent across cards: '€0.90', '€1.90', and '€0' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) vs the broken '€NaN'.
issues.suggestion: Standardize currency formatting (e.g., always two decimals or use 'Free' for €0) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'DELIVER TO' label and delivery metadata text use light gray on white, which may have insufficient contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text).
